lines.heard: p = P not E to the power KT. It starts at 100 and doubles every 7.5 hours. Find K.
lines.said: P equals P nought E to the power K T. It starts at one hundred and doubles every seven point five hours. Find K.

lines.heard: E is involved, so take ln of both sides. lnE is one, so 7.5k = ln2.
lines.said: E is involved, so take L N of both sides. L N E is one, so seven point five K equals L N two.

lines.heard: So K equals LN 2 over 7.5 about 0.0924.
lines.said: So K equals L N two over seven point five, about zero point zero nine two four.
